snippet.title: The Fight Business - Official UI Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Fight Business!

In this video we're taking a deeper look at the user interface of The Fight Business, our upcoming MMA management simulator developed by two brothers at Arkatee Studios.

We've spent over a year developing the game and wanted to give everyone a closer look at what we've been working on behind the scenes.

From managing your gym and developing fighters to planning training camps, analysing opponents and preparing fight strategies, this video gives you a look at the systems you'll be using to build your own MMA legacy.

In The Fight Business, you can:

Scout, recruit and develop MMA fighters

Build your gym and hire coaching staff

Track fighter attributes, progression and careers

Develop tactics and prepare for opponents

Guide unknown prospects towards world championships

Experience a simulated MMA world with evolving fighters and promotions

We're still actively developing the game so some of the UI and features you see may change before release.

We'd genuinely love to hear what everyone thinks. If there's anything you'd like to see improved or added, let us know in the comments!

🎮 Wishlist The Fight Business on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5457790/The_Fight_Business/

Developed by Arkatee Studios.

Leave your legacy. Become a Legend.
